result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps, providing a baseline level of pedestrian access. However, the lack of visible pedestrian signals and the presence of wide turning radii suggest a design that prioritizes vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, which can lead to unsafe crossings.
hazards.location_in_image: At the signal poles on the right and left.

hazards.name: Wide Curb Radius
hazards.description: The corner design allows vehicles to make right turns at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: The corner curb between the two visible crosswalks.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs to reduce crossing distance and slow turning traffic.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility crosswalks and pedestrian signals, providing basic infrastructure for walkers. However, the wide roadway and long crossing distances without a median refuge increase pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracking and patches in the asphalt within the crosswalk area may present a minor trip hazard.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the cracked and patched asphalt to ensure a smooth, level walking surface.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, signalized intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks and sidewalks. However, the environment is dominated by multiple travel lanes and long crossing distances without physical refuge, which increases pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic in a single stage, increasing their time of exposure to vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: There are no median islands to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians who cannot complete the crossing in one signal cycle.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Visible cracking and wear in the asphalt surface could pose a minor trip hazard or affect vehicle stopping distances.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Install raised median islands to break up the crossing distance and provide a safe haven for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Upgrade standard transverse markings to continental or ladder-style markings to improve visibility to approaching drivers.

result.summary: The image shows a wide intersection with a marked ladder-style crosswalk and overhead traffic signals. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps and markings are present, the environment is dominated by wide lanes and a large commercial driveway, creating significant conflict points for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for an extended period.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground.

hazards.name: Commercial Driveway Conflict
hazards.description: A wide entrance to a commercial parking lot creates a large area where turning vehicles and pedestrians may collide right at the crossing point.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image, adjacent to the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in two stages and reduce exposure.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.
